scope: Prospective canonical-interval midpoint/face-band tensor-grid capacity and conditioning screen; no 3D mesh or field assembly
axis_rule: Only exact distinct canonical conductor/domain planes are mandatory; recursively bisect by exact rational midpoint rounded once to binary64; left-first traversal; reject midpoint collapse, never snap
spacing_rule: Near size for intervals with closed overlap of any conductor face band; otherwise bounded far size; band edges never inserted; canonical interior intervals may remain coarse
cell_rule: Cartesian product; exclude full conductor index ranges; six consistently oriented Kuhn tetrahedra per retained cell, not generated by this study
count_gates: Conservative full tensor node bound and exact prospective dielectric tetrahedron count against unchanged toy/sentinel mesh caps
conditioning_rule: Conservative kappa2(J)^2 <= 30*(max_axis_width/min_axis_width)^2 <= 10000^2; geometry screen only, not a field accuracy or global matrix bound
repeat_rule: Byte-identical complete local1/repeat1 plans from fresh workers
infeasible_policy: Retain all computed plans including failed planning checks; no generation or automatic tuning; stop only on worker/geometry/coverage failure
width_budget_rule: Global minimum canonical gap g; width floor f=min(g, near_size/4); maximum target min(nominal_far_size, 10000*f/12); near target min(near_size, maximum target); recheck unchanged condition gate on actual stored widths
